310	def solve_layout(intent: LayoutIntent, scene: Scene, milestones: list[MilestoneInfo],
311	                 ) -> tuple[list[SolvedAction], list[SolvedEarthwork], list[SolvedCraneAction],
312	                            ValidationResult, list[str]]:
313	    """把清洗后的意图落位成具体动作、土方区域与塔吊动作，并对结果场景自检。
314	
315	    求解在场景副本上进行，原场景不被修改；执行顺序（删除 → 修改 → 基坑 → 布置 →
316	    回填 → 移动 → 塔吊动作）是刻意的：先腾出空间、先落基坑，后续对象才能参照它避让。
317	    无法落位的条目跳过并记入 notes，绝不产出违规位置。
318	    """
319	    working = scene.model_copy(deep=True)
320	    actions: list[SolvedAction] = []
321	    earthworks: list[SolvedEarthwork] = []
322	    crane_actions: list[SolvedCraneAction] = []
323	    notes: list[str] = []
324	    active = _active_rank(scene, milestones)
325	
326	    # 1) 删除先做，腾出空间。
327	    for spec in intent.removals:
328	        if spec.object_id:
329	            targets = [obj for obj in working.objects if obj.id == spec.object_id]
330	        else:
331	            targets = [obj for obj in working.objects if obj.kind == spec.kind]
332	            if not spec.all_of_kind:
333	                targets = targets[:1]
334	        if not targets:
335	            notes.append("删除指令未匹配到对象。")
336	        for target in targets:
337	            working.objects.remove(target)
338	            actions.append(SolvedAction(op="remove", object_id=target.id, note=f"删除 {target.name}"))
339	
340	    # 2) 修改（改完立即参与后续避让）。
341	    for spec in intent.modifications:
342	        obj = next((item for item in working.objects if item.id == spec.object_id), None)
343	        if obj is None:
344	            continue
345	        update: dict = {}
346	        if spec.size is not None:
347	            update["size"] = spec.size
348	        if spec.rotation_y is not None:
349	            update["rotation_y"] = _snap(spec.rotation_y, ROT_SNAP)
350	        if spec.phase_rank is not None:
351	            update["phase"] = spec.phase_rank
352	        changed = obj.model_copy(update=update)
353	        working.objects[working.objects.index(obj)] = changed
354	        actions.append(SolvedAction(op="modify", object_id=changed.id, object=changed, note=f"修改 {changed.name}"))
355	
356	    # 3) 基坑先于普通对象（塔吊等常要参照基坑落位）。
357	    for spec in intent.excavations:
358	        obj = SceneObject(
359	            id=_new_id("excavation"),
360	            name=_serial_name("excavation", working.objects, None),
361	            kind="excavation",
362	            position=Vec2(x=0, z=0),
363	            size=Size(width=spec.width, depth=spec.depth_size),
364	            rotation_y=0,
365	            movable=False,
366	            phase=spec.phase_rank if spec.phase_rank is not None else active,
367	        )
368	        desired = target_point(obj, spec, scene, working.objects)
369	        position = find_spot(obj, desired, scene, working.objects)
370	        if position is None:
371	            notes.append(f"{obj.name} 未找到可行位置，已跳过。")
372	            continue
373	        obj = obj.model_copy(update={"position": position})
374	        working.objects.append(obj)
375	        actions.append(SolvedAction(
376	            op="add", object_id=obj.id, object=obj,
377	            note=f"基坑 {spec.width:g}×{spec.depth_size:g}m，挖深 {spec.dig_depth:g}m",
378	        ))
379	        half_w, half_d = spec.width / 2, spec.depth_size / 2
380	        earthworks.append(SolvedEarthwork(
381	            id=f"earthwork-ai-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}",
382	            name=f"开挖 {obj.name}",
383	            type="cut",
384	            polygon=[
385	                Vec2(x=position.x - half_w, z=position.z - half_d),
386	                Vec2(x=position.x + half_w, z=position.z - half_d),
387	                Vec2(x=position.x + half_w, z=position.z + half_d),
388	                Vec2(x=position.x - half_w, z=position.z + half_d),
389	            ],
390	            depth=spec.dig_depth,
391	            slope_ratio=spec.slope_ratio,
392	            milestone_rank=obj.phase,
393	            linked_object_id=obj.id,
394	        ))
395	
396	    # 4) 布置新对象。
397	    for spec in intent.placements:
398	        if spec.reference_id and spec.reference_id.startswith("@"):
399	            resolved = _resolve_reference(spec.reference_id, working.objects)
400	            if resolved is None:
401	                notes.append(f"参照 {spec.reference_id} 未找到对应对象，已按场地方位布置。")
402	                spec = spec.model_copy(update={"reference_id": None, "relation": None, "side": None})
403	            else:
404	                spec = spec.model_copy(update={"reference_id": resolved})
405	        default_w, default_d, _default_name, movable = DEFAULT_SIZES[spec.kind]
406	        for _ in range(spec.count):
407	            obj = SceneObject(
408	                id=_new_id(spec.kind),
409	                name=_serial_name(spec.kind, working.objects, spec.name if spec.count == 1 else None),
410	                kind=spec.kind,
411	                position=Vec2(x=0, z=0),
412	                size=spec.size or Size(width=default_w, depth=default_d),
413	                rotation_y=_snap(spec.rotation_y or 0, ROT_SNAP),
414	                movable=movable,
415	                phase=spec.phase_rank if spec.phase_rank is not None else active,
416	            )
417	            if spec.relation == "along_edge" and spec.anchor in {"east", "west"}:
418	                obj = obj.model_copy(update={"rotation_y": 90.0})
419	            desired = target_point(obj, spec, scene, working.objects)
420	            position = find_spot(obj, desired, scene, working.objects)
421	            if position is None:
422	                notes.append(f"{obj.name} 未找到可行位置，已跳过。")
423	                continue
424	            obj = obj.model_copy(update={"position": position})
425	            working.objects.append(obj)
426	            where = ANCHOR_LABELS.get(spec.side or spec.anchor or "center", "")
427	            reference = next((item.name for item in working.objects if item.id == spec.reference_id), None)
428	            note = f"已布置在{reference or '场地'}{where}" if (reference or spec.anchor) else "已自动选位"
429	            actions.append(SolvedAction(op="add", object_id=obj.id, object=obj, note=note))
430	
431	    # 5) 土方回填：有参照时区域取参照对象轮廓（如"回填基坑"），否则按方位选一块空地。
432	    for spec in intent.fills:
433	        resolved_ref = _resolve_reference(spec.reference_id, working.objects)
434	        ref = next((item for item in working.objects if item.id == resolved_ref), None) if resolved_ref else None
435	        if spec.reference_id and ref is None:
436	            notes.append("回填指令的参照对象未找到，已按方位选择区域。")
437	        rank = spec.phase_rank if spec.phase_rank is not None else active
438	        if ref is not None:
439	            width = spec.width or ref.size.width
440	            depth_size = spec.depth_size or ref.size.depth
441	            center = ref.position
442	            name = f"回填 {ref.name}"
443	            linked = ref.id
444	        else:
445	            width = spec.width or 20.0
446	            depth_size = spec.depth_size or 15.0
447	            probe = SceneObject(
448	                id=_new_id("temporary"), name="回填区域", kind="temporary",
449	                position=Vec2(x=0, z=0), size=Size(width=width, depth=depth_size), phase=rank,
450	            )
451	            desired = target_point(probe, spec, scene, working.objects)
452	            center = find_spot(probe, desired, scene, working.objects)
453	            if center is None:
454	                notes.append("回填区域未找到可行位置，已跳过。")
455	                continue
456	            name = f"回填区域 {width:g}×{depth_size:g}m"
457	            linked = None
458	        half_w, half_d = width / 2, depth_size / 2
459	        earthworks.append(SolvedEarthwork(
460	            id=f"earthwork-ai-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}",
461	            name=name,
462	            type="fill",
463	            polygon=[
464	                Vec2(x=center.x - half_w, z=center.z - half_d),
465	                Vec2(x=center.x + half_w, z=center.z - half_d),
466	                Vec2(x=center.x + half_w, z=center.z + half_d),
467	                Vec2(x=center.x - half_w, z=center.z + half_d),
468	            ],
469	            depth=spec.fill_height,
470	            slope_ratio=spec.slope_ratio,
471	            milestone_rank=rank,
472	            linked_object_id=linked,
473	        ))
474	
475	    # 6) 移动既有对象。
476	    for spec in intent.moves:
477	        if spec.reference_id and spec.reference_id.startswith("@"):
478	            spec = spec.model_copy(update={"reference_id": _resolve_reference(spec.reference_id, working.objects)})
479	        obj = next((item for item in working.objects if item.id == spec.object_id), None)
480	        if obj is None:
481	            notes.append(f"移动指令未匹配到对象 {spec.object_id}。")
482	            continue
483	        if spec.direction:
484	            dx, dz = ANCHOR_DIR[spec.direction]
485	            distance = spec.distance_m if spec.distance_m else 5.0
486	            desired = Vec2(x=obj.position.x + dx * distance, z=obj.position.z + dz * distance)
487	        else:
488	            desired = target_point(obj, spec, scene, [item for item in working.objects if item.id != obj.id])
489	        position = find_spot(obj, desired, scene, working.objects, exclude_id=obj.id)
490	        if position is None:
491	            notes.append(f"{obj.name} 未找到可行的新位置，保持原位。")
492	            continue
493	        moved = obj.model_copy(update={"position": position})
494	        working.objects[working.objects.index(obj)] = moved
495	        actions.append(SolvedAction(op="move", object_id=moved.id, object=moved, note=f"移动 {moved.name}"))
496	
497	    # 7) 塔吊机构动作（最后做：塔吊/目标可能是本轮刚布置或移动过的）。
498	    for spec in intent.crane_actions:
499	        crane_id = _resolve_reference(spec.object_id, working.objects) if spec.object_id else None
500	        crane = next((item for item in working.objects if item.id == crane_id), None) if crane_id else None
501	        if crane is None and spec.object_id is None:
502	            crane = next((item for item in reversed(working.objects) if item.kind == "tower_crane"), None)
503	        if crane is None or crane.kind != "tower_crane":
504	            notes.append("塔吊动作未匹配到塔吊对象，已跳过。")
505	            continue
506	        slew_deg = spec.slew_deg
507	        trolley = spec.trolley_radius_m
508	        note_parts: list[str] = []
509	        target_id = _resolve_reference(spec.target_reference_id, working.objects)
510	        target = next((item for item in working.objects if item.id == target_id), None) if target_id else None
511	        if spec.target_reference_id and target is None:
512	            notes.append("塔吊转向的目标对象未找到，已忽略转向。")
513	        if target is not None:
514	            dx = target.position.x - crane.position.x
515	            dz = target.position.z - crane.position.z
516	            distance = math.hypot(dx, dz)
517	            if distance < 0.5:
518	                notes.append(f"{target.name} 与塔吊几乎同点，无法计算转向方位。")
519	            else:
520	                slew_deg = round(math.degrees(math.atan2(dx, -dz)) % 360, 1)
521	                if trolley is None:
522	                    trolley = distance
523	                note_parts.append(f"转向 {target.name}")
524	        elif slew_deg is not None:
525	            slew_deg = round(slew_deg % 360, 1)
526	            note_parts.append(f"回转至方位 {slew_deg:g}°")
527	        elif spec.slew_delta_deg:
528	            slew_delta = round(spec.slew_delta_deg, 1)
529	            note_parts.append(f"{'顺时针' if slew_delta > 0 else '逆时针'}回转 {abs(slew_delta):g}°")
530	        if trolley is not None:
531	            trolley = round(max(CRANE_RADIUS_MIN, min(CRANE_RADIUS_MAX, trolley)), 1)
532	            note_parts.append(f"小车幅度 {trolley:g}m")
533	        if spec.hook == "ground":
534	            note_parts.append("吊钩放至地面")
535	        elif spec.hook == "up":
536	            note_parts.append("吊钩收起")
537	        elif spec.hook_drop_m is not None:
538	            note_parts.append(f"吊钩下放 {spec.hook_drop_m:g}m")
539	        if not note_parts:
540	            continue
541	        crane_actions.append(SolvedCraneAction(
542	            object_id=crane.id, name=crane.name,
543	            slew_deg=slew_deg,
544	            slew_delta_deg=spec.slew_delta_deg if slew_deg is None and target is None and spec.slew_delta_deg else None,
545	            trolley_radius_m=trolley,
546	            hook=spec.hook, hook_drop_m=spec.hook_drop_m,
547	            note=f"{crane.name}：" + "、".join(note_parts),
548	        ))
549	
550	    validation = validate_scene(working)
551	    return actions, earthworks, crane_actions, validation, notes

554	def compose_reply(intent: LayoutIntent, actions: list[SolvedAction], earthworks: list[SolvedEarthwork],
555	                  crane_actions: list[SolvedCraneAction],
556	                  validation: ValidationResult, notes: list[str]) -> str:
557	    """把求解结果汇总成一句面向用户的中文答复，并附校核结论与遗留说明。"""
558	    if intent.reply and not actions and not earthworks and not crane_actions:
559	        return intent.reply
560	    parts: list[str] = []
561	    added = [action.object.name for action in actions if action.op == "add" and action.object]
562	    moved = [action.object.name for action in actions if action.op == "move" and action.object]
563	    removed = [action.note.removeprefix("删除 ") for action in actions if action.op == "remove"]
564	    modified = [action.object.name for action in actions if action.op == "modify" and action.object]
565	    if added:
566	        parts.append(f"拟新增 {'、'.join(added)}")
567	    cut_count = sum(1 for earthwork in earthworks if earthwork.type == "cut")
568	    fill_count = len(earthworks) - cut_count
569	    if cut_count:
570	        parts.append(f"生成 {cut_count} 项土方开挖")
571	    if fill_count:
572	        parts.append(f"生成 {fill_count} 项土方回填")
573	    if moved:
574	        parts.append(f"移动 {'、'.join(moved)}")
575	    if modified:
576	        parts.append(f"修改 {'、'.join(modified)}")
577	    if removed:
578	        parts.append(f"删除 {'、'.join(removed)}")
579	    if crane_actions:
580	        parts.append("塔吊动作：" + "；".join(action.note for action in crane_actions))
581	    if not parts:
582	        if notes:
583	            return ((intent.reply + " ") if intent.reply else "") + "未能生成可行的布置：" + " ".join(notes)
584	        return intent.reply or "未能理解这条指令，请换一种说法，例如：在基坑北侧加一个塔吊。"
585	    summary = "；".join(parts) + "。"
586	    error_count = sum(1 for issue in validation.issues if issue.severity == "error")
587	    warn_count = len(validation.issues) - error_count
588	    if error_count or warn_count:
589	        summary += f"校核发现 {error_count} 个错误、{warn_count} 个提醒。"
590	    else:
591	        summary += "校核通过。"
592	    if notes:
593	        summary += " " + " ".join(notes)
594	    summary += " 请在场景中查看预览，确认后点击“应用”。"
595	    return (intent.reply + " " if intent.reply else "") + summary

653	def serialize_context(request: LayoutAssistRequest) -> str:
654	    """把场地、阶段、对象清单与近期对话压成模型可读的上下文文本。
655	
656	    对象超过 60 个时只给统计量 + 与本轮指令相关的对象，避免上下文膨胀导致解析质量下降。
657	    """
658	    scene = request.scene
659	    half_w, half_d = scene.site_width / 2, scene.site_depth / 2
660	    lines = [
661	        f"【场地】宽 {scene.site_width:g}m × 深 {scene.site_depth:g}m。坐标原点在场地中心，"
662	        f"x∈[-{half_w:g},{half_w:g}]（东为+x），z∈[-{half_d:g},{half_d:g}]（北为-z）。",
663	    ]
664	    if request.milestones:
665	        stages = " ".join(f"{m.rank}:{m.name}" for m in sorted(request.milestones, key=lambda m: m.rank))
666	        lines.append(f"【施工阶段】{stages}（当前阶段 rank={_active_rank(scene, request.milestones)}）")
667	    lines.append("【现有对象清单】")
668	    objects = scene.objects
669	    if len(objects) > 60:
670	        counts: dict[str, int] = {}
671	        for obj in objects:
672	            counts[obj.kind] = counts.get(obj.kind, 0) + 1
673	        lines.append("（对象较多，仅列统计与相关对象）" + " ".join(f"{KIND_LABELS.get(k, k)}×{v}" for k, v in counts.items()))
674	        objects = [obj for obj in objects if obj.name in request.message or KIND_LABELS.get(obj.kind, "") in request.message]
675	    if not objects:
676	        lines.append("（场地为空）")
677	    for obj in objects:
678	        # 「移除于」只作为现状描述给模型参考；本阶段模型不产出 phase_end 意图（属 LR-05 范畴）。
679	        lifespan = f"阶段{obj.phase}" + (f"→{obj.phase_end}" if obj.phase_end is not None else "→末尾")
680	        lines.append(
681	            f"- id={obj.id} {obj.name} kind={obj.kind} 位置({obj.position.x:g},{obj.position.z:g}) "
682	            f"尺寸{obj.size.width:g}×{obj.size.depth:g} 旋转{obj.rotation_y:g}° {lifespan}"
683	        )
684	    if request.history:
685	        lines.append("【最近对话】")
686	        for message in request.history[-8:]:
687	            speaker = "用户" if message.role == "user" else "助手"
688	            lines.append(f"{speaker}: {message.content[:300]}")
689	    lines.append("【本轮指令】")
690	    lines.append(request.message)
691	    return "\n".join(lines)

694	def _drop_nulls(value):
695	    """递归剔除 null 字段：模型习惯把骨架里未用到的字段填 null，
696	    会撞上带默认值的非可空字段（如 slope_ratio），剔除后让 Pydantic 默认值生效。"""
697	    if isinstance(value, dict):
698	        return {key: _drop_nulls(item) for key, item in value.items() if item is not None}
699	    if isinstance(value, list):
700	        return [_drop_nulls(item) for item in value]
701	    return value

704	def parse_model_intent(content: str) -> LayoutIntent:
705	    """校验模型输出；容忍 JSON 被再包一层字符串。"""
706	    try:
707	        result = json.loads(content)
708	        if isinstance(result, str):
709	            result = json.loads(result)
710	    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
711	        raise ValueError("模型未返回有效 JSON。") from error
712	    if not isinstance(result, dict):
713	        raise ValueError("模型输出必须是 JSON 对象。")
714	    return LayoutIntent.model_validate(_drop_nulls(result))

722	def interpret_layout_with_model(request: LayoutAssistRequest) -> LayoutIntent:
723	    """调用推理网关把本轮指令解析为布置意图；网关不可用时抛出可降级的上游错误。"""
724	    if not settings.qa_api_key:
725	        raise UpstreamModelError("QA_API_KEY is not configured")
726	    url = f"{settings.qa_api_url}/chat/completions"
727	    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {settings.qa_api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
728	    payload = build_payload(LAYOUT_SYSTEM_PROMPT, serialize_context(request))
729	    try:
730	        response = None
731	        for attempt in (1, 2):
732	            try:
733	                # 推理类模型带思考过程，复杂句实测 10-25s；30s 太贴近极限，网关稍慢即超时。
734	                with httpx.Client(timeout=settings.layout_request_timeout) as client:
735	                    response = client.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)
736	                    response.raise_for_status()
737	                break
738	            except TRANSIENT_GATEWAY_ERRORS as error:
739	                if attempt == 2:
740	                    raise
741	                logging.getLogger("uvicorn.error").warning("布置助手网关瞬时故障（%s），0.5s 后重试一次。", type(error).__name__)
742	                time.sleep(0.5)
743	            except httpx.HTTPStatusError as error:
744	                if attempt == 2 or error.response.status_code < 500:
745	                    raise
746	                logging.getLogger("uvicorn.error").warning("布置助手网关返回 %s，0.5s 后重试一次。", error.response.status_code)
747	                time.sleep(0.5)
748	        body = response.json()
749	        content = body["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
750	        if not isinstance(content, str):
751	            raise ValueError("模型响应缺少文本内容。")
752	        return parse_model_intent(content)
753	    except (httpx.HTTPError, KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
754	        # Do not include provider response data: it could contain sensitive context.
755	        raise UpstreamModelError(f"布置意图解析失败：{type(error).__name__}") from error

800	    """按出现位置返回文本中全部 (别名, kind)，长别名优先且互不重叠、kind 去重。
801	
802	    支持"带塔吊和办公区的场地"这类单子句多目标句式。

804	    taken: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
805	    hits: list[tuple[int, str, str]] = []

"""智能体工具注册表：统一签名 tool(session, params) -> BaseModel。

from app.services.validation_service import validate_scene

ToolFn = Callable[[SessionState, BaseModel], BaseModel]

_registry: dict[str, tuple[type[BaseModel], ToolFn]] = {}


def _register(name: str, params_model: type[BaseModel]):
    def decorator(fn: ToolFn) -> ToolFn:
        _registry[name] = (params_model, fn)
        return fn
    return decorator


def registered_tools() -> list[str]:
    return list(_registry)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 工具实现
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

@_register("scene_snapshot", EmptyParams)
def scene_snapshot(session: SessionState, params: EmptyParams) -> SceneSnapshotResult:
    """会话场景的结构化摘要：对象清单、边界、阶段、已解析约束。"""
    scene = session.scene
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for obj in scene.objects:
        counts[obj.kind] = counts.get(obj.kind, 0) + 1
    summary = (
        f"场地 {scene.site_width:g}×{scene.site_depth:g}m，当前阶段 rank={scene.active_milestone}，"
        f"共 {len(scene.objects)} 个对象"
        + ("：" + "、".join(f"{KIND_LABELS.get(k, k)}×{v}" for k, v in counts.items()) if counts else "（场地为空）")
    )
    return SceneSnapshotResult(
        site_width=scene.site_width,
        site_depth=scene.site_depth,
        active_milestone=scene.active_milestone,
        objects=scene.objects,
        milestones=session.milestones,
        constraints=scene.constraints,
        summary=summary,
    )


@_register("apply_intent", LayoutIntent)
def apply_intent(session: SessionState, params: LayoutIntent) -> ApplyIntentResult:
    """把结构化布置意图经 sanitize → solve 落到会话场景副本。

    成功后自动保存一份场景检查点（编号递增），供 reset_to_checkpoint 回滚；
    未能落位的条目记入 notes，不产出违规位置。
    """
    intent, sanitize_notes = sanitize_intent(params, session.scene, session.milestones)
    actions, earthworks, crane_actions, validation, solve_notes = solve_layout(
        intent, session.scene, session.milestones,
    )
    # solve_layout 在副本上求解且不回写；把动作重放到会话场景，成为后续调用的基线。
    working = session.scene
    for action in actions:
        if action.op == "remove":
            working.objects = [obj for obj in working.objects if obj.id != action.object_id]
        elif action.object is not None:
            existing = next((i for i, obj in enumerate(working.objects) if obj.id == action.object_id), None)
            if existing is None:
                working.objects.append(action.object)
            else:
                working.objects[existing] = action.object
    session.earthworks.extend(earthworks)
    session.crane_actions.extend(crane_actions)
    session.checkpoints.append(working.model_copy(deep=True))
    session.checkpoint_earthworks.append([e.model_copy(deep=True) for e in session.earthworks])
    session.checkpoint_crane_actions.append([c.model_copy(deep=True) for c in session.crane_actions])
    return ApplyIntentResult(
        actions=actions,
        earthworks=earthworks,
        crane_actions=crane_actions,
        validation=validation,
        notes=sanitize_notes + solve_notes,
        checkpoint_id=len(session.checkpoints) - 1,
    )


@_register("validate", EmptyParams)
def validate(session: SessionState, params: EmptyParams):
    """对会话场景当前状态执行总平面规则校核。"""
    return validate_scene(session.scene)


@_register("diff", EmptyParams)
def diff(session: SessionState, params: EmptyParams) -> SceneDiffResult:
    """会话场景相对初始快照的对象级 diff（新增/删除/移动/修改 + 土方 + 塔吊动作）。"""
    initial = {obj.id: obj for obj in session.initial_scene.objects}
    current = {obj.id: obj for obj in session.scene.objects}
    changes: list[ObjectChange] = []
    for obj_id, obj in current.items():
        before = initial.get(obj_id)
        if before is None:
            changes.append(ObjectChange(object_id=obj_id, name=obj.name, change="added", after=obj))
        elif before != obj:
            moved_only = before.model_copy(update={"position": obj.position}) == obj
            changes.append(ObjectChange(
                object_id=obj_id, name=obj.name,
                change="moved" if moved_only else "modified",
                before=before, after=obj,
            ))
    for obj_id, obj in initial.items():
        if obj_id not in current:
            changes.append(ObjectChange(object_id=obj_id, name=obj.name, change="removed", before=obj))
    return SceneDiffResult(
        changes=changes,
        earthworks=session.earthworks,
        crane_actions=session.crane_actions,
        is_empty=not changes and not session.earthworks and not session.crane_actions,
    )


@_register("reset_to_checkpoint", ResetParams)
def reset_to_checkpoint(session: SessionState, params: ResetParams) -> ResetResult:
    """回滚会话场景到指定检查点（0 号为初始快照），其后的检查点全部丢弃。"""
    if params.checkpoint_id >= len(session.checkpoints):
        raise AgentToolError(
            f"检查点 {params.checkpoint_id} 不存在（当前共 {len(session.checkpoints)} 个，编号 0–{len(session.checkpoints) - 1}）。"
        )
    index = params.checkpoint_id
    session.scene = session.checkpoints[index].model_copy(deep=True)
    session.earthworks = [e.model_copy(deep=True) for e in session.checkpoint_earthworks[index]]
    session.crane_actions = [c.model_copy(deep=True) for c in session.checkpoint_crane_actions[index]]
    del session.checkpoints[index + 1:]
    del session.checkpoint_earthworks[index + 1:]
    del session.checkpoint_crane_actions[index + 1:]
    return ResetResult(
        checkpoint_id=index,
        object_count=len(session.scene.objects),
        note=f"已回滚到检查点 {index}，当前场景含 {len(session.scene.objects)} 个对象。",
    )


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 统一调用入口 + 审计 trace
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _summarize(result: BaseModel) -> str:
    """出参摘要：只取关键字段，避免 trace 膨胀（完整出参可由重放复现）。"""
    if isinstance(result, ApplyIntentResult):
        return (
            f"actions={len(result.actions)} earthworks={len(result.earthworks)} "
            f"crane_actions={len(result.crane_actions)} valid={result.validation.valid} "
            f"issues={len(result.validation.issues)} checkpoint={result.checkpoint_id}"
        )
    if isinstance(result, SceneDiffResult):
        return f"changes={len(result.changes)} earthworks={len(result.earthworks)} empty={result.is_empty}"
    if isinstance(result, SceneSnapshotResult):
        return result.summary
    if isinstance(result, ResetResult):
        return result.note
    data = result.model_dump()
    if "valid" in data and "issues" in data:
        return f"valid={data['valid']} issues={len(data['issues'])}"
    return type(result).__name__


def call_tool(session: SessionState, tool_name: str, raw_params: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[BaseModel, TraceEntry]:
    """统一工具调用入口：校验入参 → 执行 → 落审计 trace。

    trace 中的 params 保存调用方原文（而非二次校验后的模型导出），
    确保重放时走完全相同的校验路径。
    """
    entry = _registry.get(tool_name)
    if entry is None:
        raise AgentToolError(f"未知工具：{tool_name}。可用工具：{'、'.join(_registry)}")
    params_model, fn = entry
    try:
        params = params_model.model_validate(raw_params)
    except ValidationError as error:
        raise AgentToolError(f"工具 {tool_name} 入参不合法：{error.error_count()} 处错误。{error.errors()[:3]!r}") from error
    started = time.perf_counter()
    result = fn(session, params)
    duration_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
    trace_entry = TraceEntry(
        seq=len(session.trace),
        tool=tool_name,
        params=raw_params,
        result_summary=_summarize(result),
        duration_ms=round(duration_ms, 2),
        timestamp=time.time(),
    )
    session.trace.append(trace_entry)
    return result, trace_entry

"""场地规则校核：按注册的规则集合自检总平面。

校核结果只描述问题，不决定如何修改场景——修改由布置求解器或用户操作发起。

具体判定不在本模块：每条规则是 `services/rules/` 下的一个类，由注册器按场景
约束装配。布局求解器调用同一个注册器，因此两侧看到完全相同的阈值与几何判断
（轨道红线 5）。本模块只负责挑出参与判定的对象、依次跑规则、汇总结论。
"""

from app.schemas.scene import Scene, SceneObject

    footprint_overlap,
    polygons_intersect,
    segment_distance,
)
from app.services.rules.registry import (
    CONSTRAINT_VALUE_RANGE,
    DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS,
    build_rule_context,
)

__all__ = [
    "CONSTRAINT_VALUE_RANGE",
    "DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS",
    "clear_distance",
    "footprint_corners",
    "footprint_overlap",
    "polygons_intersect",
    "segment_distance",
    "validate_scene",

# 原 apply_constraints() 已随规则注册表移除：约束不再只映射成三个阈值，
# 还会生成规则实例，单返回一张阈值表会漏掉泛化约束。需要装配结果的调用方
# 直接用 rules.registry.build_rule_context()。


def _is_active_at(obj: SceneObject, milestone_rank: int) -> bool:
    """对象的生命周期区间 [phase, phase_end]（含两端点）是否覆盖指定阶段。

    区间倒挂（phase_end < phase）时以出现阶段为准，视为只在该阶段存在，
    与前端 isObjectVisibleAt 的规整口径一致，避免异常数据让对象在任何阶段都消失。
    """
    if milestone_rank < obj.phase:
        return False
    return obj.phase_end is None or milestone_rank <= max(obj.phase_end, obj.phase)


def validate_scene(scene: Scene) -> ValidationResult:
    """按当前阶段校核总平面，逐条跑注册的规则。

    只校核生命周期区间 [phase, phase_end]（含两端点）覆盖 active_milestone 的对象：
    尚未出现与已被拆除的对象都不参与判定，phase_end 缺省表示存在至时间轴终点。
    过滤先于规则判定，因此已拆除的对象既不会自己报问题，也不会牵连他人。
    """
    context, notes = build_rule_context(scene.constraints)
    objects = [obj for obj in scene.objects if _is_active_at(obj, scene.active_milestone)]

    issues: list[Issue] = []
    for rule in context.rules:
        issues.extend(rule.evaluate(scene, objects, context))

    return ValidationResult(
        valid=not any(issue.severity == "error" for issue in issues),
        issues=issues,
        notes=notes,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import json

from fastapi import APIRouter
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

from app.schemas.layout import LayoutAssistRequest, LayoutAssistResponse
from app.services import layout_service

router = APIRouter()


def _sse(event: str, data) -> str:
    return f"event: {event}\ndata: {json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False)}\n\n"


@router.post("/api/layout/assist", response_model=LayoutAssistResponse)
def layout_assist(request: LayoutAssistRequest) -> LayoutAssistResponse:
    """自然语言布置：解析意图（模型或离线规则）→ 确定性求解 → 校核后返回预览方案。"""
    return layout_service.assist(request)


@router.post("/api/layout/assist/stream")
def layout_assist_stream(request: LayoutAssistRequest) -> StreamingResponse:
    """流式版布置接口：thinking 事件实时推送模型思维链，result 事件推送最终方案。"""

    def event_stream():
        for kind, payload in layout_service.stream_assist_events(request):
            if kind == "thinking":
                yield _sse("thinking", payload)
            else:
                yield _sse("result", json.loads(payload.model_dump_json()))

    return StreamingResponse(
        event_stream(),
        media_type="text/event-stream",
        headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache", "X-Accel-Buffering": "no"},
    )

"""场景领域模型：场地、对象、约束。"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class Vec2(BaseModel):
    x: float
    z: float


class Size(BaseModel):
    width: float = Field(gt=0)
    depth: float = Field(gt=0)


# Single source of truth for placeable kinds; the frontend asset library must stay a subset.
SceneKind = Literal[
    "tower_crane", "excavation", "excavator", "office", "rebar_yard",
    "fire_lane", "temporary", "fence", "road",
]

# Kinds that other objects are allowed to cross, so overlap with them is not an error.
OVERLAP_EXEMPT_KINDS = {"fire_lane", "road"}

# 允许彼此重叠的类型对：工程机械可以站在它正在作业的基坑里。
OVERLAP_EXEMPT_PAIRS: frozenset[frozenset[str]] = frozenset({
    frozenset({"excavator", "excavation"}),
})


class SceneObject(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str
    kind: SceneKind
    position: Vec2
    size: Size
    rotation_y: float = 0
    movable: bool = True
    phase: int = Field(default=0, ge=0, description="Stage rank (order index) the object appears at.")
    phase_end: int | None = Field(
        default=None, ge=0,
        description="Stage rank the object is removed at (inclusive); None means it lasts to the end of the timeline.",
    )


class Constraint(BaseModel):
    type: Literal["min_distance", "min_width", "separate_zone", "inside_boundary"]
    target: str | None = None
    related_target: str | None = None
    value_m: float | None = None
    source_text: str


class Scene(BaseModel):
    site_width: float = Field(default=100, gt=0)
    site_depth: float = Field(default=60, gt=0)
    active_milestone: int = Field(
        default=999, ge=0,
        description="Stage rank; only objects whose [phase, phase_end] span covers this rank are validated.",
    )
    objects: list[SceneObject]
    constraints: list[Constraint] = []

def test_full_tool_chain():

"""规范文本结构化解析：模型解析为主，离线正则为降级路径。

未配置推理网关密钥时整条链路自动退化为规则解析，保证功能始终可用。
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re

import httpx

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.exceptions import UpstreamModelError
from app.schemas.scene import Constraint
from app.schemas.validation import ConstraintResult

CONSTRAINT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """你是施工总平面规范解析器。把用户输入的中文规范、项目要求转换为 JSON。
只返回一个 JSON 对象，格式必须为：
{
  \"constraints\": [
    {
      \"type\": \"min_distance|min_width|separate_zone|inside_boundary\",
      \"target\": \"tower_crane|excavation|fire_lane|office|rebar_yard|temporary_facilities|work_area\" 或 null,
      \"related_target\": 同上或 null,
      \"value_m\": 数值或 null,
      \"source_text\": \"对应的原始条文片段\"
    }
  ]
}
规则：只抽取文本中明确表达的约束；不确定时不要臆造；`value_m` 单位统一为米；不要输出 Markdown、解释或代码。"""


def build_payload(system_prompt: str, user_prompt: str, temperature: float = 0.1,
                  top_p: float = 0.9, use_rf: bool = True) -> dict:
    """Build a request body for the configured OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint."""
    payload: dict = {
        "model": settings.qa_model,
        "messages": [
            {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
            {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt},
        ],
        "temperature": temperature,
        "top_p": top_p,
    }
    if use_rf:
        payload["response_format"] = {"type": "json_object"}
    return payload


def parse_model_constraints(content: str) -> list[Constraint]:
    """Validate model output before it enters the deterministic layout workflow."""
    try:
        result = json.loads(content)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
        raise ValueError("模型未返回有效 JSON。") from error
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        raise ValueError("模型输出必须是 JSON 对象。")
    return [Constraint.model_validate(item) for item in result.get("constraints", [])]


def interpret_with_model(text: str) -> list[Constraint]:
    if not settings.qa_api_key:
        raise UpstreamModelError("QA_API_KEY is not configured")
    url = f"{settings.qa_api_url}/chat/completions"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {settings.qa_api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    try:
        with httpx.Client(timeout=settings.constraint_request_timeout) as client:
            response = client.post(url, headers=headers, json=build_payload(CONSTRAINT_SYSTEM_PROMPT, text))
            response.raise_for_status()
        body = response.json()
        content = body["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
        if not isinstance(content, str):
            raise ValueError("模型响应缺少文本内容。")
        return parse_model_constraints(content)
    except (httpx.HTTPError, KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
        # Do not include provider response data: it could contain sensitive context.
        raise UpstreamModelError(f"模型约束解析失败：{type(error).__name__}") from error


# 中文说法 → 对象类型。覆盖 9 类可布置对象的正式名与常见简称。
# 顺序即匹配优先级：长别名必须排在其子串之前，否则"钢筋加工棚"会先被"钢筋"截断。
KIND_ALIASES: list[tuple[str, str]] = [
    ("塔式起重机", "tower_crane"), ("塔吊", "tower_crane"), ("塔机", "tower_crane"),
    ("基坑", "excavation"), ("土方开挖区", "excavation"), ("开挖区", "excavation"),
    ("挖掘机", "excavator"), ("挖机", "excavator"), ("反铲", "excavator"),
    ("项目办公区", "office"), ("办公区", "office"), ("办公用房", "office"), ("办公室", "office"),
    ("钢筋加工棚", "rebar_yard"), ("加工棚", "rebar_yard"), ("钢筋棚", "rebar_yard"),
    ("钢筋加工区", "rebar_yard"),
    ("临时材料堆场", "temporary"), ("材料堆场", "temporary"), ("临时堆场", "temporary"),
    ("堆场", "temporary"), ("料场", "temporary"),
    ("消防通道", "fire_lane"), ("消防车道", "fire_lane"),
    ("围挡", "fence"), ("围墙", "fence"), ("围栏", "fence"),
    ("施工道路", "road"), ("场内道路", "road"), ("道路", "road"),
]

#: 别名交替式，按上表顺序拼接以保证长别名优先匹配。
_ALIAS_PATTERN = "|".join(alias for alias, _ in KIND_ALIASES)
_VALUE_PATTERN = r"(?:不小于|不少于|至少|大于等于|≥|不得小于)\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:米|m|M)?"

_DISTANCE_RE = re.compile(
    rf"({_ALIAS_PATTERN})\s*(?:与|距离|距|离|到|和)\s*({_ALIAS_PATTERN})"
    rf"(?:的)?(?:净距|间距|距离|安全距离)?\s*{_VALUE_PATTERN}"
)
_WIDTH_RE = re.compile(
    rf"({_ALIAS_PATTERN})\s*(?:的)?(?:净宽|宽度|最小宽度|宽)\s*{_VALUE_PATTERN}"
)


def _resolve_kind(alias: str) -> str | None:
    return next((kind for name, kind in KIND_ALIASES if name == alias), None)


def interpret_with_rules(text: str) -> list[Constraint]:
    """离线降级解析：未配置推理网关密钥时的兜底路径。

    只认"某类 距 某类 不小于 N 米"与"某类 净宽 不小于 N 米"两种句式，
    两侧的对象类型都走别名表泛化——因此新增对象类型时只需扩表，无需改正则。
    识别不出的句子宁可不产出约束，也不猜测用户意图。
    """
    constraints: list[Constraint] = []

    for match in _DISTANCE_RE.finditer(text):
        primary, secondary = _resolve_kind(match.group(1)), _resolve_kind(match.group(2))
        # 同类之间的净距（如"围挡距围挡"）没有实际语义，跳过。
        if primary is None or secondary is None or primary == secondary:
            continue
        constraints.append(Constraint(
            type="min_distance", target=primary, related_target=secondary,
            value_m=float(match.group(3)), source_text=match.group(0),
        ))

    for match in _WIDTH_RE.finditer(text):
        kind = _resolve_kind(match.group(1))
        if kind is None:
            continue
        constraints.append(Constraint(
            type="min_width", target=kind, value_m=float(match.group(2)),
            source_text=match.group(0),
        ))

    if "红线" in text or "场地边界" in text:
        constraints.append(Constraint(type="inside_boundary", target="temporary_facilities", source_text="场地边界/红线要求"))
    if "办公区" in text and ("作业区" in text or "加工区" in text):
        constraints.append(Constraint(type="separate_zone", target="office", related_target="work_area", source_text="办公区与作业区隔离"))
    return constraints


def interpret(text: str) -> ConstraintResult:
    """把规范文本解析为结构化约束：配置了推理网关走模型，否则走离线规则。

    与布置助手不同，这里的模型失败不降级——规范解析结果会直接影响校核阈值，
    静默退回正则会让用户以为条文已被完整理解，故失败即上抛。
    """
    text = text.strip()
    if settings.qa_api_key:
        return ConstraintResult(
            constraints=interpret_with_model(text),
            note=f"已由模型 {settings.qa_model} 解析；结果已通过服务端 Schema 校验。",
        )
    return ConstraintResult(
        constraints=interpret_with_rules(text),
        note="未配置 QA_API_KEY，已使用离线规则式解析。",
    )

"""FastAPI 应用入口：创建实例、CORS、全局异常处理器、挂载总路由。"""
from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from app.api.api_router import api_router
from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.exceptions import (
    AgentSessionNotFoundError,
    AgentToolError,
    AppError,
    ImageryRequestError,
    ImageryUnavailableError,
    TerrainDataError,
    UpstreamModelError,
)

app = FastAPI(title=settings.app_title, version=settings.app_version)
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=settings.cors_allow_origins,
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

# 业务异常 → HTTP 状态码。业务层只表达「什么问题」，状态码在这一层决定。
ERROR_STATUS_CODES: dict[type[AppError], int] = {
    TerrainDataError: 422,
    ImageryRequestError: 422,
    ImageryUnavailableError: 502,
    UpstreamModelError: 502,
    AgentSessionNotFoundError: 404,
    AgentToolError: 422,
}
DEFAULT_ERROR_STATUS_CODE = 500


@app.exception_handler(AppError)
async def handle_app_error(request: Request, error: AppError) -> JSONResponse:
    """统一按 {"detail": ...} 返回，与 FastAPI HTTPException 的响应体格式一致。"""
    status_code = next(
        (code for error_type, code in ERROR_STATUS_CODES.items() if isinstance(error, error_type)),
        DEFAULT_ERROR_STATUS_CODE,
    )
    return JSONResponse(status_code=status_code, content={"detail": error.detail})


app.include_router(api_router)

import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { storeToRefs } from 'pinia'
import { site, useSceneStore } from '../store/useSceneStore'
import { postInterpretConstraints, postValidate } from '../api/client'
import type { Constraint, Issue } from '../types/scene'
import type { ScenePayload } from '../types/api'

/**
 * 规则校核：场景快照组装、/api/validate 调用与问题列表状态；
 * 以及规范文本 → 结构化约束的解析闭环。
 *
 * 模块级单例：issues/apiMessage 被多个面板（校核、AI 对话）共享。
 * scenePayload 把本地阶段稳定 id 转为后端使用的 rank（数组下标），
 * 并把 rotation 映射为 rotation_y——这是前后端字段契约，勿改。
 * 对象生命周期区间以 phase / phase_end 两个 rank 提交，后端只校核区间覆盖当前阶段的对象。
 */
const issues = ref<Issue[]>([])
const isChecking = ref(false)
const apiMessage = ref('')
const prompt = ref('塔吊距基坑边不小于 3m；消防通道宽度不小于 4m；办公区与作业区隔离。')
const interpretedConstraints = ref<Constraint[]>([])

export function useValidation() {
  const sceneStore = useSceneStore()
  const { objects, activeMilestone } = storeToRefs(sceneStore)
  const errorCount = computed(() => issues.value.filter((item) => item.severity === 'error').length)

  function scenePayload(): ScenePayload {
    return {
      site_width: site.width,
      site_depth: site.depth,
      active_milestone: sceneStore.milestoneRank(activeMilestone.value),
      constraints: interpretedConstraints.value,
      objects: objects.value.map((item) => ({
        id: item.id,
        name: item.name,
        kind: item.kind,
        position: item.position,

50	                           scene: "Scene", relaxed: bool = False) -> bool:
51	        """候选对象放在当前位置是否满足全部适用规则——布局求解的落位判据。
52	
53	        `relaxed` 为真时放弃 `relaxable` 的建议性规则（如办公与作业区隔离）：
54	        求解器先按全部规则找位，找不到才放宽重找一轮，避免软性建议导致对象
55	        完全无法落位。硬性规则（越界、重叠、塔吊净距）两轮都不放宽。
56

58	        布置会调用上千次，全场判定会让代价随既有对象数平方增长。
59	        """

61	            if not rule.position_dependent:

64	                continue

# 放置顺序：大足迹与不可移动的先落，后落的对象才有得参照、有得避让
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

#: kind → 放置优先级（小者先放）。同优先级内按意图中的出现顺序，保证确定性。
#: 依据是"谁的位置最难改"：基坑不可移动且足迹最大，通道/道路是骨架，
#: 大型功能区次之，塔吊要参照基坑落位故排在其后，零散小对象最后见缝插针。
PLACEMENT_PRIORITY: dict[str, int] = {
    "excavation": 0,
    "fire_lane": 1,
    "road": 1,
    "office": 2,
    "rebar_yard": 2,
    "temporary": 2,
    "tower_crane": 3,
    "excavator": 4,
    "fence": 4,
}
DEFAULT_PRIORITY = 5

#: 不可移动的对象无论类型都最先放：它们落不下就是真落不下，没有让位的余地。
IMMOVABLE_PRIORITY = -1


def placement_priority(spec: PlacementSpec) -> int:
    """一条布置意图的放置优先级。不可移动的对象一律优先于按类型排序的其余对象。"""
    movable = DEFAULT_SIZES[spec.kind][3]
    return IMMOVABLE_PRIORITY if not movable else PLACEMENT_PRIORITY.get(spec.kind, DEFAULT_PRIORITY)


def order_placements(placements: list[PlacementSpec]) -> list[PlacementSpec]:
    """按优先级表稳定排序。

    用 `sorted` 而非就地排序以保持稳定性：同优先级的对象维持用户描述中的先后，
    因此同一段文本反复求解得到完全相同的顺序（确定性要求）。
    """
    return sorted(placements, key=placement_priority)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 关系偏好：规则管不着、但用户明确表达了的那部分诉求
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

#: 偏好项在评分中的标识，与规则代码区分开（前者是"用户想要"，后者是"规范要求"）。
PREF_NEAR = "PREF_NEAR"
PREF_ANCHOR = "PREF_ANCHOR"

#: 偏好罚分的每米权重。刻意远低于规则违反的量级（见 base.PENALTY_PER_METER），
#: 保证"离期望位置远一点"永远优于"违反一条规范"。
PREF_PER_METER = 0.35

#: 偏好扣分的上限：离期望位置极远时不该把总分拉到与硬性违规同级，
#: 否则求解器会为了贴近方位而接受违规位置。
PREF_PENALTY_CAP = 25.0


def _preference_penalties(candidate: SceneObject, spec: PlacementSpec, scene: Scene,
                          working_objects: list[SceneObject], desired: Vec2,
                          near_weight: float, anchor_weight: float) -> list[RulePenalty]:
    """候选位置偏离用户表达的关系诉求多少——这部分不属于规则，故不走注册表。

    两类偏好各自按"离期望落点的米数"计分，权重由策略给出（见 STRATEGIES）：
    `near` 看离参照对象的期望间距，`anchor` 看离该方位理想落点的距离。
    """
    penalties: list[RulePenalty] = []
    drift = math.hypot(candidate.position.x - desired.x, candidate.position.z - desired.z)
    if drift <= GRID_SNAP:
        return penalties

    reference = next(
        (item for item in working_objects if item.id == spec.reference_id), None,
    ) if spec.reference_id else None

    if spec.relation == "near" and reference is not None:
        penalties.append(RulePenalty(
            rule=PREF_NEAR,
            penalty=min(drift * PREF_PER_METER * near_weight, PREF_PENALTY_CAP),
            explain=f"{candidate.name} 距 {reference.name} 的理想位置偏了 {drift:.1f}m。",
        ))
    elif spec.anchor:
        where = ANCHOR_LABELS.get(spec.anchor, spec.anchor)
        penalties.append(RulePenalty(
            rule=PREF_ANCHOR,
            penalty=min(drift * PREF_PER_METER * anchor_weight, PREF_PENALTY_CAP),
            explain=f"{candidate.name} 距场地{where}的理想位置偏了 {drift:.1f}m。",
        ))
    return penalties


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 策略：只影响"合法候选中挑哪个"，不影响"哪些候选合法"
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

#: 两版策略的偏好权重。方位优先看重贴合用户指定的方位/参照；
#: 紧凑优先把偏好权重压低，于是求解器更愿意接受靠近场地中心、彼此集中的位置。
STRATEGIES: dict[str, tuple[SitePlanStrategy, float, float]] = {
    "anchor_first": (SitePlanStrategy(key="anchor_first", label="方位优先"), 1.0, 1.0),
    "compact_first": (SitePlanStrategy(key="compact_first", label="紧凑优先"), 0.35, 0.2),
}


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 择优落位：在合法候选中取罚分最小
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

#: 择优搜索的候选点上限。螺旋搜索本身可铺满整个场地，但整场求解要做十余次落位，
#: 逐点算罚分会把代价抬一个量级；取到足够多的合法候选即停，剩下的更远候选
#: 只会更差（罚分随偏离距离单调增），继续搜没有收益。
MAX_SCORED_CANDIDATES = 12

#: 罚分比较的容差：低于此差值视为同分，取先找到的（更靠近期望落点）那个，
#: 避免浮点噪声让同一输入在不同机器上选出不同位置（确定性要求）。
SCORE_EPSILON = 1e-6


def _spiral_offsets(max_radius: int):
    """由内向外的螺旋候选偏移，与 find_spot 同一套采样（每圈 16 个方向）。"""
    yield (0.0, 0.0)
    for radius in range(1, max_radius + 1):
        for step in range(16):
            yield (
                radius * math.cos(step * math.pi / 8),
                radius * math.sin(step * math.pi / 8),
            )


def find_best_spot(obj: SceneObject, desired: Vec2, spec: PlacementSpec, scene: Scene,
                   working_objects: list[SceneObject], context, near_weight: float,
                   anchor_weight: float) -> tuple[Vec2, list[RulePenalty]] | None:
    """在合法候选中取罚分最小的位置，返回落点与该位置的扣分明细。

    与 `find_spot` 的"首个合法即返回"相比，这里继续向外搜集至多
    MAX_SCORED_CANDIDATES 个合法候选再择优。合法性判定与罚分都出自规则注册表，
    因此择优不会选出校核会报错的位置（轨道红线 5）。

    找不到任何合法位置时返回 None——由调用方记入未放置清单，不硬塞。
    """
    half_w, half_d = scene.site_width / 2, scene.site_depth / 2
    ehw, ehd = _effective_half_extents(obj)
    max_radius = int(math.ceil(max(scene.site_width, scene.site_depth)))
    others = [other for other in working_objects if other.id != obj.id]

    # 与 find_spot 一致的两轮语义：先按全部规则找，找不到再放宽建议性规则。
    for relaxed in (False, True):
        best: tuple[float, Vec2, list[RulePenalty]] | None = None
        seen: set[tuple[float, float]] = set()
        scored = 0
        for off_x, off_z in _spiral_offsets(max_radius):
            x = _snap(desired.x + off_x, GRID_SNAP)
            z = _snap(desired.z + off_z, GRID_SNAP)
            x = max(-(half_w - ehw), min(half_w - ehw, x))
            z = max(-(half_d - ehd), min(half_d - ehd, z))
            # 越界钳制会把外圈候选压到同一批边界点上，去重避免重复计分。
            if (x, z) in seen:
                continue
            seen.add((x, z))
            candidate = obj.model_copy(update={"position": Vec2(x=x, z=z)})
            if not context.candidate_is_valid(candidate, others, scene, relaxed=relaxed):
                continue
            penalties = context.candidate_penalties(candidate, others, scene)
            penalties += _preference_penalties(
                candidate, spec, scene, working_objects, desired, near_weight, anchor_weight,
            )
            total = sum(item.penalty for item in penalties)
            if best is None or total < best[0] - SCORE_EPSILON:
                best = (total, Vec2(x=x, z=z), penalties)
            scored += 1
            if scored >= MAX_SCORED_CANDIDATES:
                break
        if best is not None:
            return best[1], best[2]
    return None


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 整场求解
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def solve_site_plan(intent: SitePlanIntent, scene: Scene, milestones: list[MilestoneInfo],
                    strategy_key: str = "anchor_first") -> SitePlanVariant:
    """把整场意图落位成一版完整方案。

    求解在场景副本上进行，原场景不被修改。约束先并入场景（用户在本段要求里
    提到的规范随即对落位生效），再按优先级表逐个择优落位，最后整体校核。
    无法落位的对象进入未放置清单，绝不产出违规位置。
    """
    strategy, near_weight, anchor_weight = STRATEGIES.get(strategy_key, STRATEGIES["anchor_first"])
    working = scene.model_copy(deep=True)
    # 本轮解析出的约束并入场景后一并装配规则，因此"消防通道不小于 5m"这类要求
    # 在本次落位时就生效，而不是等应用后才由校核报出来。
    working.constraints = list(working.constraints) + list(intent.constraints)
    context, constraint_notes = build_rule_context(working.constraints)
    active = _active_rank(scene, milestones)

    actions: list[SolvedAction] = []
    earthworks: list[SolvedEarthwork] = []
    unplaced: list[UnplacedItem] = []
    scores: list[PlacementScore] = []

    for spec in order_placements(intent.placements):
        default_w, default_d, _default_name, movable = DEFAULT_SIZES[spec.kind]
        for _ in range(spec.count):
            obj = SceneObject(
                id=_new_id(spec.kind),
                name=_serial_name(spec.kind, working.objects, spec.name if spec.count == 1 else None),
                kind=spec.kind,
                position=Vec2(x=0, z=0),
                size=spec.size or Size(width=default_w, depth=default_d),
                rotation_y=_snap(spec.rotation_y or 0, ROT_SNAP),
                movable=movable,
                phase=spec.phase_rank if spec.phase_rank is not None else active,
            )
            if spec.relation == "along_edge" and spec.anchor in {"east", "west"}:
                obj = obj.model_copy(update={"rotation_y": 90.0})

            resolved = _resolve_pending_reference(spec, working.objects)
            desired = target_point(obj, resolved, scene, working.objects)
            found = find_best_spot(
                obj, desired, resolved, scene, working.objects, context, near_weight, anchor_weight,
            )
            if found is None:
                unplaced.append(UnplacedItem(
                    kind=spec.kind, name=obj.name,
                    reason=f"场地内找不到同时满足各项规则的位置，{obj.name}未布置。",
                ))
                continue
            position, penalties = found
            obj = obj.model_copy(update={"position": position})
            working.objects.append(obj)
            actions.append(SolvedAction(
                op="add", object_id=obj.id, object=obj,
                note=_placement_note(resolved, working.objects),
            ))
            scores.append(PlacementScore(
                object_id=obj.id, name=obj.name,
                total_penalty=round(sum(item.penalty for item in penalties), 2),
                breakdown=[
                    PenaltyItem(rule=item.rule, penalty=round(item.penalty, 2), explain=item.explain)
                    for item in sorted(penalties, key=lambda item: -item.penalty)
                ],
            ))
            if spec.kind == "excavation":
                earthworks.append(_excavation_earthwork(obj))

    validation = validate_scene(working)
    total = round(sum(score.total_penalty for score in scores), 2)
    return SitePlanVariant(
        strategy=strategy,
        actions=actions,
        earthworks=earthworks,
        validation=validation,
        unplaced=unplaced,
        scores=scores,
        total_penalty=total,
        explanation=compose_explanation(actions, unplaced, validation, scores, constraint_notes),
    )


def _resolve_pending_reference(spec: PlacementSpec, working_objects: list[SceneObject]) -> PlacementSpec:
    """把 "@kind" 参照解析为本轮已落位的具体对象。

    整场模式下参照多半指向同一批意图里的对象（"塔吊靠近基坑"），而基坑由优先级表
    保证先落位，因此这里总能解析到。解析不到时退化为按方位布置，不阻断整场求解。
    """
    reference_id = spec.reference_id
    if not reference_id or not reference_id.startswith("@"):
        return spec
    kind = reference_id[1:]
    match = next((obj for obj in reversed(working_objects) if obj.kind == kind), None)
    if match is None:
        return spec.model_copy(update={"reference_id": None, "relation": None, "side": None})
    return spec.model_copy(update={"reference_id": match.id})


def _placement_note(spec: PlacementSpec, working_objects: list[SceneObject]) -> str:
    where = ANCHOR_LABELS.get(spec.side or spec.anchor or "center", "")
    reference = next((item.name for item in working_objects if item.id == spec.reference_id), None)
    if reference or spec.anchor:
        return f"已布置在{reference or '场地'}{where}"
    return "已自动选位"


def _excavation_earthwork(obj: SceneObject) -> SolvedEarthwork:
    """基坑对象附带的开挖土方区域。

    整场模式的基坑来自 placements（对象清单语义）而非 excavations，故挖深不由
    用户逐个指定，按对象短边的经验比例取值并钳到合理区间——具体深度用户可在
    应用后于土方操作清单中调整。
    """
    dig_depth = max(2.0, min(8.0, round(min(obj.size.width, obj.size.depth) * 0.25, 1)))
    half_w, half_d = obj.size.width / 2, obj.size.depth / 2
    return SolvedEarthwork(
        id=f"earthwork-ai-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}",
        name=f"开挖 {obj.name}",
        type="cut",
        polygon=[
            Vec2(x=obj.position.x - half_w, z=obj.position.z - half_d),
            Vec2(x=obj.position.x + half_w, z=obj.position.z - half_d),
            Vec2(x=obj.position.x + half_w, z=obj.position.z + half_d),
            Vec2(x=obj.position.x - half_w, z=obj.position.z + half_d),
        ],
        depth=dig_depth,
        slope_ratio=0.5,
        milestone_rank=obj.phase,
        linked_object_id=obj.id,
    )


def compose_explanation(actions: list[SolvedAction], unplaced: list[UnplacedItem],
                        validation: ValidationResult, scores: list[PlacementScore],
                        constraint_notes: list[str]) -> str:
    """一段面向用户的中文说明：布置了什么、校核结论、哪些没放下、主要扣分在哪。"""
    parts: list[str] = []
    added = [action.object.name for action in actions if action.object]
    parts.append(f"已布置 {len(added)} 个对象：{'、'.join(added)}。" if added else "本次未能布置任何对象。")

    error_count = sum(1 for issue in validation.issues if issue.severity == "error")
    warn_count = len(validation.issues) - error_count
    if error_count or warn_count:
        parts.append(f"校核发现 {error_count} 个错误、{warn_count} 个提醒。")
    else:
        parts.append("校核通过。")

    if unplaced:
        parts.append("未能放置：" + "、".join(item.name for item in unplaced) + "。")

    top = top_penalties(scores, limit=3)
    if top:
        parts.append("主要权衡：" + "；".join(item.explain for item in top) + "。")
    if constraint_notes:
        parts.append(" ".join(constraint_notes))
    return " ".join(parts)


def top_penalties(scores: list[PlacementScore], limit: int = 3) -> list[PenaltyItem]:
    """全场扣分最高的前若干项，供前端评分卡展示。"""
    items = [item for score in scores for item in score.breakdown]
    return sorted(items, key=lambda item: -item.penalty)[:limit]

#: 离线降级时的默认关系模板：文本没说方位时，按这张表给各类对象一个合理的默认方位。
#: 依据是常规施工总平面的惯例——生活办公区远离作业面、加工棚与堆场靠近基坑、
#: 通道沿边布置。它只影响期望落点，最终位置仍由求解器按规则择优。
DEFAULT_ANCHORS: dict[str, str] = {
    "excavation": "center",
    "office": "southwest",
    "rebar_yard": "east",
    "temporary": "northeast",
    "fire_lane": "south",
    "road": "north",
    "tower_crane": "center",
    "excavator": "center",
    "fence": "west",
}

#: 离线降级时的默认参照关系：这些对象天然围绕基坑作业，文本没写关系时按此关联。
DEFAULT_NEAR_EXCAVATION = {"tower_crane", "excavator"}


def interpret_site_plan_with_rules(message: str, scene: Scene,
                                   milestones: list[MilestoneInfo]) -> SitePlanIntent:
    """离线降级路径：从整段文本抽出对象清单 + 默认关系模板。

    复用逐条指令路径的 `_find_kinds`（长别名优先、互不重叠、kind 去重），
    因此两条路径认得的对象类型天然一致，不会出现"在线认得、离线不认得"。
    方位与阶段按子句就近解析：某个对象所在子句里出现的方位词优先于默认模板。
    """
    from app.services.constraint_service import interpret_with_rules as parse_constraints
    from app.services.layout_service import _find_anchor

    clauses = [clause for clause in __import__("re").split(r"[，。；,;\n]", message) if clause.strip()]
    # kind → (方位, 阶段)：同一对象在多个子句出现时以首次出现的子句为准。
    seen: dict[str, tuple[str | None, int | None]] = {}
    for clause in clauses:
        anchor = _find_anchor(clause)
        phase_rank = _parse_phase_rank(clause, milestones)
        for _alias, kind in _find_kinds(clause):
            if kind not in seen:
                seen[kind] = (anchor, phase_rank)
            elif seen[kind] == (None, None):
                seen[kind] = (anchor, phase_rank)

    placements: list[PlacementSpec] = []
    for kind, (anchor, phase_rank) in seen.items():
        near_excavation = kind in DEFAULT_NEAR_EXCAVATION and "excavation" in seen
        placements.append(PlacementSpec(
            kind=kind,
            # 文本明确说了方位就听用户的；没说才落到默认模板。
            anchor=None if near_excavation else (anchor or DEFAULT_ANCHORS.get(kind)),
            relation="near" if near_excavation else None,
            reference_id="@excavation" if near_excavation else None,
            phase_rank=_clamp_rank(phase_rank, milestones),
        ))

    notes: list[str] = []
    if not placements:
        notes.append("未能从描述中识别出要布置的对象，请点名需要哪些设施（如塔吊、办公区、堆场）。")
    return SitePlanIntent(
        placements=placements,
        # 量化要求走规范解析的同一套正则，与规则注册表消费的结构完全一致。
        constraints=parse_constraints(message),
        notes=notes,
    )


def interpret_site_plan_with_model(request: SitePlanRequest) -> SitePlanIntent:
    """调用推理网关把整段要求解析为整场意图；网关不可用时抛出可降级的上游错误。"""
    import json

    import httpx

    from app.services.constraint_service import build_payload
    from app.services.layout_service import _drop_nulls, serialize_context

    if not settings.qa_api_key:
        raise UpstreamModelError("QA_API_KEY is not configured")
    url = f"{settings.qa_api_url}/chat/completions"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {settings.qa_api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    # 上下文序列化与逐条指令路径共用：场地尺寸、阶段表、现有对象清单的表述必须一致，
    # 否则模型在两个入口看到的世界不同。
    payload = build_payload(SITE_PLAN_SYSTEM_PROMPT, serialize_context(request))
    try:
        with httpx.Client(timeout=settings.layout_request_timeout) as client:
            response = client.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)
            response.raise_for_status()
        content = response.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
        if not isinstance(content, str):
            raise ValueError("模型响应缺少文本内容。")
        result = json.loads(content)
        if isinstance(result, str):
            result = json.loads(result)
        if not isinstance(result, dict):
            raise ValueError("模型输出必须是 JSON 对象。")
        return SitePlanIntent.model_validate(_drop_nulls(result))
    except (httpx.HTTPError, KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
        # 不回传网关响应体：其中可能含敏感上下文。
        raise UpstreamModelError(f"整场布置意图解析失败：{type(error).__name__}") from error


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 编排
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

FALLBACK_NOTE = "模型服务暂时不可用，本次已使用离线规则解析（按默认关系模板布置，可再用对话逐条调整）。"


def sanitize_site_plan(intent: SitePlanIntent, scene: Scene,
                       milestones: list[MilestoneInfo]) -> tuple[SitePlanIntent, list[str]]:
    """剔除引用不存在对象的条目、把阶段钳制到已定义范围。

    与 `sanitize_intent` 同一套语义，但只处理 placements——整场意图没有
    移动/删除/修改，脏引用的唯一来源是 reference_id。
    """
    notes: list[str] = []
    ids = {obj.id for obj in scene.objects}
    kinds_in_plan = {spec.kind for spec in intent.placements}

    placements: list[PlacementSpec] = []
    for spec in intent.placements:
        reference_id = spec.reference_id
        if reference_id and reference_id.startswith("@"):
            # "@kind" 只有在本轮确实要布置该类对象时才成立。
            if reference_id[1:] not in kinds_in_plan:
                notes.append(f"忽略了参照关系：本轮不布置 {reference_id[1:]}，{spec.kind} 改按方位布置。")
                spec = spec.model_copy(update={"reference_id": None, "relation": None, "side": None})
        elif reference_id and reference_id not in ids:
            notes.append(f"忽略了参照关系：{reference_id} 不在场景中，{spec.kind} 改按方位布置。")
            spec = spec.model_copy(update={"reference_id": None, "relation": None, "side": None})
        placements.append(spec.model_copy(update={"phase_rank": _clamp_rank(spec.phase_rank, milestones)}))

    return intent.model_copy(update={"placements": placements}), notes


def generate_site_plan(request: SitePlanRequest) -> SitePlanResponse:
    """一次完整的整场布置编排：解析意图 → 逐版求解 → 汇总。

    降级对调用方透明：模型不可用时就地退回离线规则解析，始终返回可用方案，
    降级事实通过 intent_source 与 notes 告知用户（轨道红线 3）。
    """
    fallback_notes: list[str] = []
    source: Literal["model", "rules"] = "rules"
    intent: SitePlanIntent | None = None
    if settings.qa_api_key:
        try:
            intent = interpret_site_plan_with_model(request)
            source = "model"
        except RuntimeError as error:
            logging.getLogger("uvicorn.error").warning(
                "整场布置模型调用降级：%s（原因：%r）", error, error.__cause__,
            )
            fallback_notes.append(FALLBACK_NOTE)
    if intent is None:
        intent = interpret_site_plan_with_rules(request.message.strip(), request.scene, request.milestones)

    intent, sanitize_notes = sanitize_site_plan(intent, request.scene, request.milestones)
    notes = fallback_notes + sanitize_notes + list(intent.notes)

    if intent.is_empty():
        return SitePlanResponse(
            reply="未能从这段描述中识别出要布置的设施，请点名需要哪些对象，"
                  "例如：布置塔吊、办公区、钢筋加工棚、堆场与消防通道。",
            validation=validate_scene(request.scene),
            intent_source=source,
            notes=notes,
        )

    keys = ["anchor_first", "compact_first"][:request.variants]
    variants = [solve_site_plan(intent, request.scene, request.milestones, key) for key in keys]
    primary = variants[0]

    reply = primary.explanation
    if len(variants) > 1:
        reply += (
            f" 另提供「{variants[1].strategy.label}」版本对比"
            f"（本版扣分 {primary.total_penalty:g}，对比版 {variants[1].total_penalty:g}）。"
        )
    reply += " 请在场景中查看预览，确认后点击“应用”。"

    return SitePlanResponse(
        reply=(" ".join(fallback_notes) + " " if fallback_notes else "") + reply,
        actions=primary.actions,
        earthworks=primary.earthworks,
        validation=primary.validation,
        unplaced=primary.unplaced,
        scores=primary.scores,
        total_penalty=primary.total_penalty,
        variants=variants,
        intent_source=source,
        notes=notes,
    )

def score_scene(scene: Scene) -> tuple[list[PlacementScore], float]:
    """给一个既有场景算罚分明细，不改动场景。

    逐个对象轮流当"候选"、其余对象当既有环境，跑与布置求解完全相同的
    `candidate_penalties`。因此同一处违规会在配对双方各记一次——这是有意的：
    智能体要知道的是"该动哪个对象"，两侧都列出来才好选代价小的那个。

    这里不含关系偏好项：偏好来自本轮意图（用户说了要靠哪儿），而既有场景
    没有附带意图，只有规则层面的好坏可评。
    """
    context, _ = build_rule_context(scene.constraints)
    scores: list[PlacementScore] = []
    for index, obj in enumerate(scene.objects):
        others = scene.objects[:index] + scene.objects[index + 1:]
        penalties = context.candidate_penalties(obj, others, scene)
        if not penalties:
            continue
        scores.append(PlacementScore(
            object_id=obj.id, name=obj.name,
            total_penalty=round(sum(item.penalty for item in penalties), 2),
            breakdown=[
                PenaltyItem(rule=item.rule, penalty=round(item.penalty, 2), explain=item.explain)
                for item in sorted(penalties, key=lambda item: -item.penalty)
            ],
        ))
    return scores, round(sum(score.total_penalty for score in scores), 2)"}

@_register("plan_site", SitePlanIntent)
def plan_site(session: SessionState, params: SitePlanIntent) -> PlanSiteResult:
    """一次生成整场布置：按优先级顺序逐个择优落位，附校核与评分明细。

    与 apply_intent 的分工：那个是"执行这一条指令"，本工具是"照这份清单摆满整场"。
    智能体的典型用法是先用本工具铺一版，用 score_plan / validate 看结果，
    再用 apply_intent 对个别对象做局部返工。

    落位后同样存检查点，返工不理想时可回滚。未能落位的对象在 unplaced 里如实返回，
    绝不硬塞违规位置——智能体应据此改清单（减对象或改关系），而不是重试同一份。
    """
    intent, sanitize_notes = sanitize_site_plan(params, session.scene, session.milestones)
    variant = solve_site_plan(intent, session.scene, session.milestones)
    checkpoint_id = _commit(session, variant.actions, variant.earthworks, [])
    return PlanSiteResult(
        strategy=variant.strategy,
        actions=variant.actions,
        earthworks=variant.earthworks,
        validation=variant.validation,
        unplaced=variant.unplaced,
        scores=variant.scores,
        total_penalty=variant.total_penalty,
        explanation=variant.explanation,
        notes=sanitize_notes + list(intent.notes),
        checkpoint_id=checkpoint_id,
    )


@_register("score_plan", EmptyParams)
def score_plan(session: SessionState, params: EmptyParams) -> ScorePlanResult:
    """对会话场景当前状态算罚分明细，不改动场景。

    评分与校核用的是同一批规则实例（轨道红线 5），因此二者不会各说各话：
    校核报错的地方必然在评分里有对应扣分。智能体据此判断"还差在哪、该动谁"。
    """
    scores, total = score_scene(session.scene)
    validation = validate_scene(session.scene)
    top = top_penalties(scores, limit=3)
    if total == 0:
        summary = f"当前场景 {len(session.scene.objects)} 个对象无规则层面的扣分。"
    else:
        summary = (
            f"当前场景合计扣分 {total:g}，主要在于："
            + "；".join(item.explain for item in top)
        )
    return ScorePlanResult(scores=scores, total_penalty=total, validation=validation, summary=summary)"}

def test_session_capacity_eviction():
    """超并发上限时淘汰最久未活动的会话。"""
    ids = [_create_session() for _ in range(session_store.MAX_SESSIONS)]
    # 拉开活跃时间：第 0 个最旧。
    for offset, sid in enumerate(ids):
        session_store.get_session(sid).last_active_at -= (len(ids) - offset)
    extra = _create_session()
    assert session_store.session_count() == session_store.MAX_SESSIONS
    assert _call(ids[0], "scene_snapshot").status_code == 404
    assert _call(extra, "scene_snapshot").status_code == 200

运行：backend 目录下 `python -m pytest tests -q`（pytest 仅本地开发安装）。
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from app.schemas.layout import (  # noqa: E402
    MilestoneInfo,
    PlacementSpec,
    SitePlanIntent,
    SitePlanRequest,
)
from app.schemas.scene import Constraint, Scene, SceneObject, Size, Vec2  # noqa: E402
from app.services.site_plan_service import (  # noqa: E402
    generate_site_plan,
    interpret_site_plan_with_rules,
    order_placements,
    sanitize_site_plan,
    score_scene,
    solve_site_plan,
)
from app.services.validation_service import validate_scene  # noqa: E402

MILESTONES = [
    MilestoneInfo(rank=0, name="现状"),
    MilestoneInfo(rank=1, name="临建布置"),
    MilestoneInfo(rank=2, name="主体施工"),
    MilestoneInfo(rank=3, name="竣工场地"),
]

#: 手工验收用的那段话，同时也是离线解析的回归样本。
SITE_PLAN_MESSAGE = "布置塔吊、办公区、钢筋加工棚、堆场、消防通道，办公区靠西南，塔吊覆盖基坑"


def make_scene(objects: list[SceneObject] | None = None, width: float = 100,
               depth: float = 60) -> Scene:
    return Scene(site_width=width, site_depth=depth, active_milestone=1, objects=objects or [])


def placement_signature(variant) -> list[tuple[str, float, float, int]]:
    """落位结果的可比指纹：对象 id 含随机后缀，比较时只看类型、坐标与阶段。"""
    return [
        (action.object.kind, action.object.position.x, action.object.position.z, action.object.phase)
        for action in variant.actions
        if action.object is not None
    ]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 固定场景 + 固定意图：结果确定且校核无 error
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_fixed_intent_solves_without_errors() -> None:
    """绕过模型，直接构造意图：9 类对象各 1 个必须全部落位且校核无 error。"""
    intent = SitePlanIntent(placements=[
        PlacementSpec(kind="excavation", anchor="center"),
        PlacementSpec(kind="fire_lane", anchor="south"),
        PlacementSpec(kind="road", anchor="north"),
        PlacementSpec(kind="office", anchor="southwest"),
        PlacementSpec(kind="rebar_yard", anchor="east"),
        PlacementSpec(kind="temporary", anchor="northeast"),
        PlacementSpec(kind="tower_crane", relation="near", reference_id="@excavation"),
        PlacementSpec(kind="excavator", anchor="center"),
        PlacementSpec(kind="fence", anchor="west"),
    ])
    variant = solve_site_plan(intent, make_scene(), MILESTONES)

    assert len(variant.actions) == 9
    assert variant.unplaced == []
    assert [issue for issue in variant.validation.issues if issue.severity == "error"] == []
    assert variant.validation.valid is True


def test_repeated_calls_are_identical() -> None:
    """连续两次调用逐字段一致——求解不得引入随机。"""
    scene = make_scene()
    request = SitePlanRequest(message=SITE_PLAN_MESSAGE, scene=scene, milestones=MILESTONES)
    first, second = generate_site_plan(request), generate_site_plan(request)

    assert placement_signature(first) == placement_signature(second)
    assert first.total_penalty == second.total_penalty
    assert first.reply == second.reply
    assert [item.model_dump() for item in first.scores] == [
        # 评分明细里只有 object_id 带随机后缀，其余字段必须逐字相同。
        item.model_dump() | {"object_id": other.object_id}
        for item, other in zip(second.scores, first.scores)
    ]


def test_excavation_placement_generates_earthwork() -> None:
    """整场模式下的基坑同样产出开挖土方，且挂在对象所属阶段。"""
    intent = SitePlanIntent(placements=[PlacementSpec(kind="excavation", phase_rank=2)])
    variant = solve_site_plan(intent, make_scene(), MILESTONES)

    assert len(variant.earthworks) == 1
    earthwork = variant.earthworks[0]
    assert earthwork.type == "cut"
    assert earthwork.milestone_rank == 2
    assert earthwork.linked_object_id == variant.actions[0].object_id


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 无解：返回未放置清单而非异常、更不硬塞违规位置
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_unsolvable_reports_unplaced_without_violation() -> None:
    """场地塞不下时列入未放置清单，已落位的部分仍须校核无 error。"""
    intent = SitePlanIntent(placements=[
        PlacementSpec(kind="excavation"),
        PlacementSpec(kind="office"),
        PlacementSpec(kind="rebar_yard"),
    ])
    variant = solve_site_plan(intent, make_scene(width=20, depth=12), MILESTONES)

    assert variant.unplaced, "小场地应至少有一个对象放不下"
    assert len(variant.actions) + len(variant.unplaced) == 3
    # 关键：放不下就是放不下，绝不硬塞——落位的那些必须依然合法。
    assert [issue for issue in variant.validation.issues if issue.severity == "error"] == []
    assert all(item.name and item.reason for item in variant.unplaced)


def test_empty_intent_returns_guidance_not_error() -> None:
    """描述里没有任何可识别对象时给出引导语，而不是抛异常或空方案。"""
    response = generate_site_plan(SitePlanRequest(
        message="随便弄弄吧", scene=make_scene(), milestones=MILESTONES,
    ))
    assert response.actions == []
    assert "点名需要哪些对象" in response.reply


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 评分：复用规则注册表，不是另写一套判定（轨道红线 5）
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_score_reuses_rule_registry_codes() -> None:
    """评分明细里的 rule 必须与校核 issue 的 code 对得上，且给出量化缺口。"""
    scene = make_scene([
        SceneObject(id="e1", name="基坑", kind="excavation", position=Vec2(x=0, z=0),
                    size=Size(width=30, depth=20), movable=False, phase=0),
        # 距基坑边 1m，规则要求 3m —— 缺口 2m。
        SceneObject(id="c1", name="塔吊", kind="tower_crane", position=Vec2(x=0, z=-13),
                    size=Size(width=4, depth=4), phase=0),
    ])
    scene.active_milestone = 0
    scores, total = score_scene(scene)
    validation = validate_scene(scene)

    scored_codes = {item.rule for score in scores for item in score.breakdown}
    issue_codes = {issue.code for issue in validation.issues}
    assert "CRANE_EXCAVATION_CLEARANCE" in scored_codes
    # 同源：校核报出的每条规则都必须在评分里有对应扣分。
    assert issue_codes <= scored_codes
    assert total > 0
    assert any("还差 2.0m" in item.explain for score in scores for item in score.breakdown)


def test_score_follows_constraint_threshold() -> None:
    """约束改写阈值后评分随之改变——证明评分读的是注册器装配出的规则，而非硬编码值。"""
    objects = [
        SceneObject(id="e1", name="基坑", kind="excavation", position=Vec2(x=0, z=0),
                    size=Size(width=30, depth=20), movable=False, phase=0),
        SceneObject(id="c1", name="塔吊", kind="tower_crane", position=Vec2(x=0, z=-14),
                    size=Size(width=4, depth=4), phase=0),
    ]
    default_scene = make_scene([obj.model_copy(deep=True) for obj in objects])
    default_scene.active_milestone = 0
    _scores, default_total = score_scene(default_scene)

    strict_scene = make_scene([obj.model_copy(deep=True) for obj in objects])
    strict_scene.active_milestone = 0
    strict_scene.constraints = [Constraint(
        type="min_distance", target="tower_crane", related_target="excavation",
        value_m=10.0, source_text="塔吊距基坑不小于 10 米",
    )]
    _strict_scores, strict_total = score_scene(strict_scene)

    assert strict_total > default_total


def test_clean_scene_scores_zero() -> None:
    """合规场景不扣分：罚分不得对合法布置产生噪声。"""
    scene = make_scene([
        SceneObject(id="o1", name="办公区", kind="office", position=Vec2(x=-30, z=20),
                    size=Size(width=18, depth=10), phase=0),
    ])
    scene.active_milestone = 0
    scores, total = score_scene(scene)
    assert scores == []
    assert total == 0


def test_solved_plan_scores_and_validation_agree() -> None:
    """求解出的方案：校核无 error，则评分里不得出现 error 档规则的扣分。"""
    variant = solve_site_plan(
        SitePlanIntent(placements=[
            PlacementSpec(kind="excavation"),
            PlacementSpec(kind="tower_crane", relation="near", reference_id="@excavation"),
            PlacementSpec(kind="office", anchor="southwest"),
        ]),
        make_scene(), MILESTONES,
    )
    assert variant.validation.valid is True
    hard_codes = {"OUT_OF_BOUNDARY", "OBJECT_OVERLAP", "CRANE_EXCAVATION_CLEARANCE"}
    scored = {item.rule for score in variant.scores for item in score.breakdown}
    assert not (scored & hard_codes)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 放置顺序、阶段与参照
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_placement_order_puts_large_footprint_first() -> None:
    """优先级表：不可移动与大足迹先放，小对象最后。"""
    ordered = order_placements([
        PlacementSpec(kind="fence"),
        PlacementSpec(kind="tower_crane"),
        PlacementSpec(kind="office"),
        PlacementSpec(kind="excavation"),
    ])
    assert [spec.kind for spec in ordered] == ["excavation", "office", "tower_crane", "fence"]


def test_phase_rank_flows_through_to_objects() -> None:
    """阶段感知：各对象挂到意图指定的里程碑，超范围的 rank 被钳制。"""
    intent = SitePlanIntent(placements=[
        PlacementSpec(kind="office", phase_rank=1),
        PlacementSpec(kind="tower_crane", phase_rank=2),
        PlacementSpec(kind="temporary", phase_rank=99),
    ])
    cleaned, _notes = sanitize_site_plan(intent, make_scene(), MILESTONES)
    variant = solve_site_plan(cleaned, make_scene(), MILESTONES)

    phases = {action.object.kind: action.object.phase for action in variant.actions}
    assert phases["office"] == 1
    assert phases["tower_crane"] == 2
    # 99 超出已定义阶段，钳到最大 rank。
    assert phases["temporary"] == 3


def test_pending_reference_resolves_to_same_turn_object() -> None:
    """"@excavation" 参照本轮新建的基坑：塔吊须落在基坑附近且满足净距。"""
    variant = solve_site_plan(
        SitePlanIntent(placements=[
            PlacementSpec(kind="excavation", anchor="center"),
            PlacementSpec(kind="tower_crane", relation="near", reference_id="@excavation", side="north"),
        ]),
        make_scene(), MILESTONES,
    )
    crane = next(a.object for a in variant.actions if a.object.kind == "tower_crane")
    excavation = next(a.object for a in variant.actions if a.object.kind == "excavation")
    # 北 = -z，且不得压在基坑上。
    assert crane.position.z < excavation.position.z
    assert variant.validation.valid is True


def test_sanitize_drops_reference_to_absent_kind() -> None:
    """参照一个本轮并不布置的类型时，退化为按方位布置并留说明。"""
    intent = SitePlanIntent(placements=[
        PlacementSpec(kind="tower_crane", relation="near", reference_id="@excavation"),
    ])
    cleaned, notes = sanitize_site_plan(intent, make_scene(), MILESTONES)
    assert cleaned.placements[0].reference_id is None
    assert cleaned.placements[0].relation is None
    assert notes


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 离线降级（轨道红线 3）
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_offline_parses_kinds_and_anchor() -> None:
    """离线路径：从整段要求抽出对象清单，文本说了方位就听用户的。"""
    intent = interpret_site_plan_with_rules(SITE_PLAN_MESSAGE, make_scene(), MILESTONES)
    kinds = {spec.kind for spec in intent.placements}
    assert {"tower_crane", "office", "rebar_yard", "temporary", "fire_lane"} <= kinds

    office = next(spec for spec in intent.placements if spec.kind == "office")
    assert office.anchor == "southwest"
    # "塔吊覆盖基坑"：塔吊改为参照基坑，而不是套默认方位。
    crane = next(spec for spec in intent.placements if spec.kind == "tower_crane")
    assert crane.relation == "near"
    assert crane.reference_id == "@excavation"


def test_offline_extracts_constraints_from_text() -> None:
    """量化要求走规范解析的同一套正则，产出规则注册表能直接消费的结构。"""
    intent = interpret_site_plan_with_rules(
        "布置塔吊和基坑，塔吊距基坑不小于 8 米", make_scene(), MILESTONES,
    )
    distance = [c for c in intent.constraints if c.type == "min_distance"]
    assert distance and distance[0].value_m == 8.0


def test_offline_full_path_produces_valid_plan(monkeypatch) -> None:
    """未配置密钥时整条链路可用，且方案校核通过（轨道红线 3）。"""
    from app.core.config import settings
    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, "qa_api_key", None)

    response = generate_site_plan(SitePlanRequest(
        message=SITE_PLAN_MESSAGE, scene=make_scene(), milestones=MILESTONES,
    ))
    assert response.intent_source == "rules"
    assert len(response.actions) >= 5
    assert response.unplaced == []
    assert response.validation.valid is True


def test_offline_phase_awareness() -> None:
    """"临建阶段布置办公区、主体施工阶段加塔吊"：两个对象各挂对应里程碑。"""
    response = generate_site_plan(SitePlanRequest(
        message="临建布置阶段布置办公区，主体施工阶段加塔吊",
        scene=make_scene(), milestones=MILESTONES,
    ))
    phases = {action.object.kind: action.object.phase for action in response.actions}
    assert phases["office"] == 1
    assert phases["tower_crane"] == 2


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 双版本对比（可选项）
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_two_variants_differ_and_stay_deterministic() -> None:
    """两版策略给出实质不同的方案，且同输入两次调用两版都逐字段一致。"""
    request = SitePlanRequest(
        message=SITE_PLAN_MESSAGE, scene=make_scene(), milestones=MILESTONES, variants=2,
    )
    first, second = generate_site_plan(request), generate_site_plan(request)

    assert [v.strategy.key for v in first.variants] == ["anchor_first", "compact_first"]
    # 两版必须真的不同：若只是同比缩放权重，最小值位置不变，对比就没有意义。
    assert placement_signature(first.variants[0]) != placement_signature(first.variants[1])
    # 但两版各自都得合法。
    assert all(v.validation.valid for v in first.variants)
    for left, right in zip(first.variants, second.variants):
        assert placement_signature(left) == placement_signature(right)
        assert left.total_penalty == right.total_penalty


def test_single_variant_by_default() -> None:
    response = generate_site_plan(SitePlanRequest(
        message=SITE_PLAN_MESSAGE, scene=make_scene(), milestones=MILESTONES,
    ))
    assert len(response.variants) == 1
    # 顶层字段是首选版本的镜像，供只关心单版的调用方直接使用。
    assert response.actions == response.variants[0].actions
    assert response.total_penalty == response.variants[0].total_penalty
